import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from fuzz import find_order, scopes_for

rng = random.Random(7)
n = 64
rib = []
for i in range(n):
    p = [((i+k) % n) + 1 for k in range(5)]
    rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000000})
    rib.append({'path': list(reversed(p)), 'count': 1000000})
while len(rib) < 2000:
    i = rng.randrange(n)
    p = [((i+k) % n) + 1 for k in range(rng.randint(2,5))]
    rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000000})
queries = []
for i in range(512):
    L = rng.randint(0, 64)
    queries.append({'id': 'q%d' % i, 'path': [rng.randint(1, n) for _ in range(L)],
                    'threshold': [rng.randint(0, 4), 4]})
doc = {'version': 1, 'ixps': [], 'rib': rib, 'priors': [], 'declared': [],
       'order': [], 'queries': queries}
core, scopes = scopes_for(doc)
order = find_order(core, scopes)
doc['order'] = [list(l) for l in order]
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
print('bytes', len(raw), 'core links', len(core))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=raw,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt = time.time() - t
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'time %.2fs' % dt, 'maxrss(MB) %.1f' % (usage.ru_maxrss/1024),
      'links', len(out.get('links', [])), 'queries', len(out.get('queries', [])))
print('stderr', p.stderr[:200])
print('sample query', json.dumps(out['queries'][0]))
PYEOF
